item.title: backlog show does not display scope field — scope globs invisible to users
item.intent: All user-set item fields must be visible via backlog show; scope globs affect sprint behavior and must be surfaced
steps: Locate cmd_backlog_show jq rendering block (lines ~4437-4458) — confirm .scope is absent from the output
After the acceptanceCriteria section, add conditional scope rendering: if .scope is non-empty, print 'Scope:' header followed by each glob on its own indented line
Match the formatting style of existing sections (blank line separator, label + content)
Run shellcheck — confirm zero new warnings
acceptanceCriteria: aishore backlog show <ID> for an item with scope=["src/**"] displays a 'Scope:' section with 'src/**' listed
aishore backlog show <ID> for an item with no scope set shows no Scope section
